label: Google Calendar: List Events
description: Lists a calendar's events in a time window, recurring events expanded to instances and ordered by start, optionally filtered by a search term. One call reads one Google page of at most `maxResults` events; to read them all, wire `nextPageToken` into the next call's `pageToken` while `hasMore` is true. A page over the 100 KB a wire carries fails the node, catchable by `_error`: lower `maxResults`.

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.label: Page size
inputs.description: The most events one page holds (Google may send fewer). A page that weighs more than the 100 KB a wire carries fails the node: lower this.

inputs.name: pageToken
inputs.label: Page token
inputs.description: Where this page starts: empty for the first page, else the `nextPageToken` the previous call handed out (Google's own token for its next page).

outputs.name: events
outputs.type: List[{ id: String, summary: String | Null, start: String | Null, end: String | Null, location: String | Null, description: String | Null, link: String }]
outputs.description: This page's events, ordered by start. Each event: id, summary, start, end, location, description, link.

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: How many events this page holds.

outputs.name: nextPageToken
outputs.description: Google's token for the next page, to wire into the next call's `pageToken`; empty after the last page.

outputs.name: hasMore
outputs.description: True when Google has a page after this one.
